checks.message: Low resolution: fine detail may be lost

lichen_planus.india: Common; hypertrophic lichen planus on the shins and lichen planus pigmentosus on the face and neck are frequent in Indian skin.
lichen_planus.dark_skin: Violaceous, dark brown or grey flat-topped papules that heal with marked dark pigmentation.
confirm: Wickham's striae (fine white lines) on lesions or inside the cheeks
Check the mouth, nails and genitals
ask: White lacy patches or soreness in the mouth?

tell_apart.cue: Psoriasis plaques have thick silvery scale
Lichenoid drug eruption follows a new drug

eczema.india: Atopic dermatitis in children, hand eczema and lichen simplex chronicus are common.
eczema.dark_skin: Looks grey, brown or violaceous rather than red; small follicular bumps; thickening and pigment change.
confirm: Flexural sites in older children and adults; face and cheeks in infants
Personal or family history of atopy
first_steps: Topical steroid of the right strength, short course, by clinician
Check for tinea (KOH) before using a steroid
ask: Is it very itchy, especially at night?
Asthma, hay fever or eczema in the family?

tell_apart.cue: Tinea has an active scaly edge with central clearing
Scabies: finger-web papules and family members itching
Contact dermatitis follows the pattern of contact

psoriasis.india: Common; involves scalp, palms/soles and nails; linked to joint disease and metabolic syndrome.
psoriasis.dark_skin: Plaques look purple, grey or dark brown with silvery scale; leaves light or dark marks.
confirm: Well-defined plaques with thick silvery scale on elbows, knees, scalp, natal cleft
KOH to exclude tinea when in doubt
refer_if: Pustular or whole-body red (erythrodermic) psoriasis: urgent
ask: Scalp scaling, nail changes or joint pain?
Recent sore throat or new drug?

tell_apart.cue: Tinea has central clearing and a positive KOH
Seborrhoeic dermatitis has greasy, thinner scale within the hairline
Pityriasis rosea starts with a herald patch and follows skin lines

df.india: Common and benign, often on the legs after a minor injury or insect bite.
df.dark_skin: Often a darker brown firm papule.
confirm: Pinch test: the lesion dimples inwards
Dermoscopy: central white patch with a fine peripheral network
refer_if: Growing, larger than 1-2 cm, or atypical
ask: Did it follow an insect bite or injury?

tell_apart.cue: Naevi do not dimple on pinching
Melanoma changes and lacks the central white patch

autoimmune_systemic.india: Includes cutaneous and systemic lupus, scleroderma, dermatomyositis and vasculitis.
autoimmune_systemic.dark_skin: Discoid lupus leaves marked light and dark pigment change and scarring; the malar rash looks less red.
confirm: Ask about joint pain, fever, mouth ulcers, Raynaud's, muscle weakness
ask: Joint pains, fever or mouth ulcers?
Fingers turning white or blue in the cold?

tell_apart.cue: Psoriasis has thick silvery scale and no scarring
Lichen planus is violaceous with Wickham's striae
